comment: Works in tandem with TamL in tirandamycin biosynthesis in a oxygenation-oxidation-oxygenation cascade. However, TamI can also produce mature tirandamycin C, albeit in an less effective fashion.

reactions.description: Hydroxylation of tirandamycin C as first tailoring step in the tirandamycin pathway. TamI oxygenation requires a specific sequence of oxygenations, showing high substrate specificity.
Hydroxylation of tirandamycin C to tirandamycin E.
Hydroxylation of tirandamycin E as second tailoring step in the tirandamycin pathway, via the TamL-independent route with spontaneous dehydration.
Hydroxylation of tirandamycin E to tirandamycin D.
Epoxidation of tirandamycin D as third tailoring step in the tirandamycin pathway.
Epoxidation of tirandamycin D to tirandamycin A.
Hydroxylation of tirandamycin A as forth tailoring step in the tirandamycin pathway.
Hydroxylation of tirandamycin A to the mature tirandamycin B.
